contract.purpose: Turn untrusted benchmark material into a bounded observation/inference/unknown evidence pack, failure-pressure contract, and exact behavior checks before any builder sees it.

evidenceRequired.description: Observation, inference and unknown fields are separated and source hashes are retained.
Source-bound checks cover input/state, spatial relation, failure/recovery, feedback sequence and terminal/replay.
Source-bound pressure records the signal, escalation, attributable failure, recovery, and no-copy boundary.
A verified gameplay recording produces a hash-bound frame manifest, reconstruction and semantic Builder contract.

passCriteria: raw source text is never forwarded as an instruction
missing evidence remains an explicit unknown
every behavior and pressure observation cites run-bound source evidence
verified gameplay recordings yield a READY event-level reconstruction before Builder handoff
all five behavior dimensions and the failure-pressure contract are ready before Builder handoff

failureRoute.rationale: Reference evidence gaps must be resolved before the mechanic lock is trusted.
